understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete the KA59 puzzle by solving each level within its step budget, with a level being won only when every goal tile marked with a '+' was occupied at the same time by a movable/selectable piece (i.e., all goals must be covered simultaneously to trigger WIN).
understanding.mechanics_understanding: A single active/selected piece is controlled. Using CLICK attempts to move the currently selected piece to the clicked grid coordinate (or select a piece if that is how the level is set up); the move only succeeds if the destination/path is valid, otherwise the piece stays in place (blocked). Using directional moves (e.g., MOVE_RIGHT) moves the selected piece in that direction until the rules allow it to stop (often sliding until an obstacle), consuming steps. Walls/obstacles prevent movement, and interactions like pushing (when allowed by the level rules) require free space in the direction of push; otherwise movement is blocked. All actions consume from the remaining step budget.
